Class Evaluate

java.lang.Object
Evaluate
public class Evaluate extends Object
Evaluates the quality of a classifier with two methods: Cross Validation and Hold-Out. For the evaluation, the train and dev datasets are merged, and then two strategies are applied:
  • 5-fold Cross Validation:
    • The data is split into 5 parts
    • In each iteration, 4 parts are used for training + 1 for testing
    • Gives a robust estimate of the error
  • Repeated Random Hold-Out (70/30):
    • A random 70% of the data (without replacement) is used for training and the other 30% for testing; the class is not used to draw the sample
    • The process is repeated several times
    • The mean and the standard deviation are computed
Metrics computed in the evaluation:
  • Accuracy
  • Precision
  • Recall
  • F-Measure (spam and legitimate)
  • Weighted average
The model used is a neural network (MultilayerPerceptron), with configurable parameters. The results are saved to a file and are also recorded in the experiment log.

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
      Main method: runs the complete evaluation of the classifier.

      The train and dev datasets are merged and then two evaluation methods are applied: Cross Validation and Repeated Hold-Out.

      Parameters:
      args - Command-line arguments:
      • args[0] - train_final.arff file
      • args[1] - dev_final.arff file
      • args[2] - file where the results are saved
      • args[3] - learning rate
      • args[4] - momentum
      • args[5] - hidden layers configuration
      • args[6] - number of epochs
      Throws:
      Exception - If an error happens during the run

    • buildMLP

      public static weka.classifiers.functions.MultilayerPerceptron buildMLP(double learningRate, double momentum, String hiddenLayers, int epochs) throws Exception
      Creates and configures a Multilayer Perceptron neural network.

      This method sets the parameters of the MLP algorithm, taking the input values and creating the MLP model with them.

      Parameters:
      learningRate - Learning rate
      momentum - Momentum value
      hiddenLayers - Hidden layers configuration (e.g. "3")
      epochs - Number of training iterations (training time)
      Returns:
      The configured MultilayerPerceptron model
      Throws:
      Exception - If a configuration error happens
